description: This is a JavaScript source file implementing API client functions for a frontend dashboard application. It includes functions to resolve an API base URL, fetch JSON data from various API endpoints related to modules overview, deployment, users, and costs, and process this data for consumption by other parts of the application.

methods.name: resolveBase()
methods.description: Resolves a reliable API base URL using environment variables, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson(url, { credentials = 'include' } = {})
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with error handling and fallback for non-JSON responses.

methods.name: toArray(data)
methods.description: Normalizes various data shapes into an array format.

methods.name: getModules()
methods.description: Fetches and returns a modules overview for the dashboard, trying multiple endpoints and deriving minimal data if needed.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics()
methods.description: Fetches consolidated overview metrics including total users and deployed applications.
